title: Kids Phone – Rechargeable Toy for Kids with 24 Learning Modes | Talking Dummy Mobile for Boys & Girls Age 2–12 | Educational Mobile Phone Toy with, Music & Games Flash Card Phone
bullets: 📱 Interactive Kids Phone with 24 Learning Modes: This realistic toy phone for kids is packed with 24 engaging functions such as music, stories, animals, fruits, body parts, colors, numbers, transport, nature sounds, and more. Designed to look and feel like a real smartphone, it’s ideal for encouraging roleplay and boosting cognitive development in children ages 2 to 12.

🔋 Rechargeable Dummy Phone – Eco-Friendly & Hassle-Free: This dummy phone features a built-in 150mAh rechargeable battery with Type-C USB charging. Fully charges in just 30 minutes and delivers 3 to 4 hours of continuous fun. No need for disposable batteries—this kids phone is eco-conscious, safe, and travel-friendly.

🎮 All-in-One Kids Mobile Phone Toy with Camera & Music: More than just a play phone, this kids mobile phone toy includes dual pretend cameras, interactive flash card games, musical tones, voice prompts, and fun lighting features. Kids can explore, imitate, and learn while building habits and language skills in a playful way.

🎁 Perfect Gift for Kids – Birthday, Holiday & Return Gift: Whether it’s for a birthday surprise, Christmas gift, or party return gift, this toy phone delights boys and girls alike. It offers both entertainment and education, giving parents peace of mind while keeping real phones safe from curious hands.

✅ Safe, Durable & Easy to Use for Toddlers: Made from non-toxic, child-safe ABS plastic with rounded edges for safety. Includes volume control, lock/unlock modes, and parental care instructions. Do not use while charging and avoid overcharging for longer life. A perfect blend of learning and fun in one compact toy phone for kids.
